context: Year-end office, Friday afternoon. Hiroshi (boss) has called in Kenji, Yuki, and Asuka (a consultant from her language school doing seasonal corporate work) for a four-way wrap-up.
purpose: four-speaker workplace year-end — professional, slightly warmer than usual

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 皆さん、今年も、本当にお疲れさまでした。
lines.en: Everyone — truly, thank you for all your work this year.
lines.style: Composed, measured opening. Warm acknowledgment beneath the formality. Even pace, brief pause before the gratitude. The voice of someone who means every word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: こちらこそ。本当に、長い一年でした。
lines.en: The same to you. It's been a long year.
lines.style: Honest and genuine, no performance. Voice steady and clear. A slight weight on 'long' — tired but not defeated. No rush, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 私、本当に、勉強させていただきました。
lines.en: I learned so much from all of you.
lines.style: Quiet and careful. Voice slightly tentative but fully present — holding the moment. Respectful cadence, soft attack, no apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 皆さんと、一緒に仕事できて、本当に良かったです。
lines.en: Working alongside all of you has been truly rewarding.
lines.style: Warm without being performed. Steady, attentive presence in the voice. Clear and unrushed. The even breath of someone speaking sincerely to people she respects.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 田中さん、本当に、よく頑張ってくれた。
lines.en: Ms. Tanaka — truly, you've worked exceptionally hard.
lines.style: Rare directness from him. Voice slightly softer than usual. Light emphasis on the compliment itself — not effusive, but genuine. Held pause before her name.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 部長…(small bow)ありがとうございます。
lines.en: Sir… (small bow) Thank you very much.
lines.style: Voice catches slightly in the bow — genuine emotion breaking through composure. Breath small and careful. The formal gratitude deepened by real feeling underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 田中さん、最初の頃から、ずっと真面目で。
lines.en: Ms. Tanaka — from the very start, always so conscientious.
lines.style: Easy, observant tone. Senior colleague speaking with genuine respect. Unforced and honest throughout — a simple, warm acknowledgment of something real.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: はじめてお会いした時、本当に、すぐにわかりました。
lines.en: When I first met you — I knew right away.
lines.style: Kind and steady. Professional but genuinely warm. Attentive presence held throughout. Calm, assured voice — someone who sees people clearly and says so.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.style: Real emotional catch in the voice. Hands clasped in the throat. Breath catching on the gratitude. Small, genuine moment — not performed, not hidden.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来年も、一緒に。仕事は、まだまだ大変だが。
lines.en: Next year too — together. Work will still be difficult ahead.
lines.style: Firm and forward-looking. Composed voice carrying quiet resolve. No rush. Brief pause before the second thought. A leader's steady conviction without harshness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、頑張ります。本当に。
lines.en: Yes — I'll do my best. Truly.
lines.style: Steady commitment in a quiet voice. Full presence held in the moment. Clear and unrushed. The sincerity of a junior affirming something important.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 私も、また、関わらせていただければ。
lines.en: I hope I may continue to be of help next year.
lines.style: Careful, modest ask. Consultant's thoughtfulness in the delivery. Steady and attentive throughout. No presumption, genuine openness to being included.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: もちろん。木村先生、本当に、ありがたい。
lines.en: Of course. Ms. Kimura — I'm truly grateful.
lines.style: Slight drop in guard. Unguarded gratitude breaking through composure. Genuine and unforced throughout. Brief pause before her name — acknowledgment of what she's offered.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 時間、皆さん、本当に、いつもありがとうございます。
lines.en: Thank you all — for your time and support this year.
lines.style: Real, settling closing line. Steady attentive presence held throughout. Calm breath. The voice of someone genuinely grateful, speaking simply.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 良いお年を。本当に、お疲れさまでした。
lines.en: Happy new year. Truly — thank you all for this year's work.
lines.style: Formal closing exchange without rush. Even pace, clear voice. Brief pause between the greeting and the gratitude. Simple, genuine, complete.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Warm and genuine closing. Voice carries the moment fully. Even breath, clear presence. Simple sincerity, no embellishment needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 良いお年を。…本当に、来年も、頼みます。
lines.en: Happy new year. …Truly — counting on all of you again next year.
lines.style: Rare warmth from him, slightly unguarded. Held pause after the greeting. Second thought carries quiet weight and genuine reliance. Steady, genuine throughout.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: …(small bow, real smile) Happy new year.
lines.style: Settled brightness breaking through. Real smile in the voice. The bow carrying genuine emotion. Open, present, no performance — just relief and connection.
